zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.17 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: 产品变更
items: 新增无需密钥的桌面手机 Electron 验收通道与可配置的 mobilecli 服务端口。
在桌面端手机 tab 中把 H264 流渲染为可见且可交互的设备画面。
桌面端手机浮层在工作台设置注册完成后再提供服务。
在 Desktop 产物中携带手机设备运行时不变量诊断所需的分片。
以明确的 CommonJS 扩展名发布动态浏览器 factory，同时保持其浏览器路由。
复用桌面端手机重连卡片，不改变交互行为。
补全手机能力的 CI 与工具目录投影，并闭合 CLI 的 request-trust 与手机工具运行时依赖。
在不使用排除项的前提下补齐 phone-runtime、phone-stream 与 ui-phone 全部源文件的行为覆盖率。
清零已交付 Desktop 手机能力面的 contracts-ready lint 债务。
让 Desktop Web 开发 watcher 解析包显式声明的 TSX client 入口。
校准手机设备 Web 快照与跨平台 CI fixture，并补全 Desktop CLI 的 phone-stream 安装闭包。
让 Desktop 从「手机设备」设置中准备、校验并热激活固定版本的 mobilecli 运行时。
让 Desktop 准备并启动固定 Android SDK、API 35 镜像与私有默认模拟器。
让 Desktop 准备并启动 iOS 模拟器、准备 iOS 设备控制代理，并为 iPhone 真机就绪失败提供可操作说明。
每台手机只展示一次，并在 H264 画面不可用时回退到可控制的 MJPEG 画面。
把桌面端手机 tab 的 swipe 编成 WDA 终点位移时长手势，使 iOS Simulator 界面可以滚动。
保留持久 assistant 中断标记，使 Mobile Companion 在分页历史与实时替换中显示既有停止标记。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.17 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Product changes
items: Add a keyless Desktop phone Electron acceptance lane and configurable mobilecli server port.
Render the Desktop phone tab's H264 stream as a visible, interactive device picture.
Wait for Desktop workbench settings registration before serving the phone overlay.
Include the phone device runtime chunks required by Desktop invariant diagnostics.
Publish dynamic browser factories with an explicit CommonJS extension while preserving their browser routes.
Share the Desktop phone reconnect card without changing its interaction behavior.
Complete phone CI and tool-catalog projections and the CLI request-trust and phone-tool runtime dependency closure.
Complete behavior coverage without exclusions for every phone-runtime, phone-stream, and ui-phone source file.
Close the contracts-ready lint debt across the delivered Desktop phone surface.
Let the Desktop Web development watcher resolve package-declared TSX client entries.
Align Phone Devices Web snapshots and cross-platform CI fixtures, and complete the Desktop CLI phone-stream installation closure.
Let Desktop prepare, verify, and hot-activate the pinned mobilecli runtime from Phone Devices settings.
Let Desktop prepare and start a pinned Android SDK, API 35 image, and private default emulator.
Let Desktop prepare and start an iOS Simulator, prepare the iOS device-control agent, and explain actionable physical-iPhone readiness failures.
Show each phone once and fall back to a controllable MJPEG picture when its H264 stream is unusable.
Encode Desktop phone-tab swipes as WDA destination-move travel pauses so iOS Simulator UI scrolls.
Preserve durable assistant interruption so Mobile Companion renders the existing stopped marker in paged history and live replacements.
